original.statement: When cluster.inClusterEnabled is set to "false", Applications currently configured to sync on the in-cluster cluster will enter Unknown state and cannot sync; new Applications cannot use the in-cluster cluster; and deleting Applications will not delete their previously managed resources.

corrected.statement: With cluster.inClusterEnabled explicitly set to "false", Applications on the in-cluster cluster become Unknown and cannot sync, new in-cluster Applications cannot be created, and deleting an Application does not delete its previously managed resources.

decision.reason: [ev-adf2ed32df1c] names the setting `cluster.inClusterEnabled` and describes a new runtime behaviour when it is explicitly "false": in-cluster Applications go to Unknown and cannot sync, new ones cannot be created, and deletion no longer removes managed resources. So config-key cluster.inClusterEnabled with behavior-changed is right, and no component should be set because the excerpt names no file or binary. The text gives no before/after literals, so the string "null" values are unsupported and are dropped.
